parameters.subject: 🎉 Welcome! Your {{ $json.coverage_type }} policy is ACTIVE

parameters.message: 🎉 Congrats {{ $json.first_name }}! Your {{ $json.coverage_type }} policy is ACTIVE! Policy #{{ $json.policy_number }}. Check your email for details. Questions? Call me anytime: {{ $env.AGENT_PHONE }} - {{ $env.AGENT_NAME }}

parameters.query:
SELECT c.*, o.*, 
  EXTRACT(DAY FROM (NOW() - c.policy_start_date)) as days_since_start,
  (c.policy_renewal_date - NOW()) as days_until_renewal
FROM clients c
JOIN onboarding_sequences o ON c.id = o.client_id
WHERE 
  (o.check_in_1_sent = false AND c.policy_start_date < NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days')
  OR (o.check_in_30_sent = false AND c.policy_start_date < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days')
  OR (o.renewal_reminder_sent = false AND c.policy_renewal_date BETWEEN NOW() AND NOW() + INTERVAL '30 days')
LIMIT 50;

UPDATE onboarding_sequences SET
  {{ $json.touchpoint.type }}_sent = true,
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE client_id = {{ $json.id }};
